description: For admissible cubic frames with nonconstant A/c, stable left-right equivalence, ordinary left-right equivalence, and equality of the decorated Artin schemes (Spec C[c]/(A/c), B mod (A/c)) up to scaling are equivalent, without squarefreeness or coprimality assumptions.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an audited LaTeX locator for every defining claim.

members.statement: For an admissible cubic frame, the coefficient content of the discriminant in the target variables is chi=gcd(A,B^2), and the primitive nonplane discriminant Delta/chi is irreducible.
members.title: Primitive Cubic-Frame Discriminant Content

members.statement: At a deleted root s of A, B(s)=0 if and only if the scheme-theoretic intersection of the primitive discriminant with the plane c=s is nonreduced.
members.title: Common Deleted Planes Are Intrinsic

members.statement: The delta_a chart of the blowup of the relative Jacobian ideal (delta_a,delta_b) is exactly A2 with coordinates (c,t), and the pulled-back ideal is generated by rho(c)H0(c,t)^3.
members.title: The Relative Jacobian Blowup Recovers the Finite-Root Chart

members.statement: If p=ord_s A0 and d=ord_s rho, then the common-factor multiplicity m is d when p is at least d and (p+d)/2 otherwise.
members.title: The Weighted Relative Jacobian Recovers Every Common-Factor Multiplicity

members.statement: For admissible cubic frames with nonconstant A/c, stable left-right equivalence, ordinary left-right equivalence, and equality of the decorated Artin schemes (Spec C[c]/(A/c), B mod (A/c)) up to scaling are equivalent, without squarefreeness or coprimality assumptions.
members.title: All-Multiplicity Fixed-Frame Torelli

members.statement: For A=c(c+1), B=-2(c+1)^2, the pulled-back relative Jacobian ideal is generated by (c+1)^2(3ct-2(c+1))^3, so the exceptional member is uniformly recorded by vertical multiplicity two.
members.title: The Exceptional q=-2 Member Is a Weighted-Jacobian Stratum

members.statement: For every coprime admissible cubic-frame pair, without assuming A squarefree, stable left-right equivalence equals ordinary left-right equivalence and is classified by scaling the decorated finite scheme Z_A=Spec C[c]/(A/c) with its unit-valued jet section B|Z_A.
